Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Everything you need to know about creating, customizing, and downloading your marriage biodata.

Is this marriage biodata maker completely free with no watermark?

Yes! Every single template (all 242 designs), ceremonial stickers, Vedic Kundali charts, photo frames, and download formats (PDF, Editable Word .docx, PNG, and JPG) are 100% free forever with zero watermarks and no signup.

How does the Editable Microsoft Word (.docx) download work?

When you click Word (.docx), our browser engine constructs a true native Word document with styled section headers, double page borders, your portrait photo alongside Personal Details, and editable two-column tables.

How do the automatic Date of Birth & Age calculation work?

Simply pick your Birth Day, Month, and Year in the Personal Details section. The studio automatically formats your Date of Birth and calculates your exact completed age in years (e.g., 28 Years).

Are my personal details and photo stored on any server?

No. Our application runs 100% inside your device's web browser. Your data is auto-saved locally in your browser's local storage and encrypted first-party cookies so you can resume anytime, or export a .json backup.

Can I add, rename, reorder, or hide fields and sections?

Yes. Click any section title or field label to rename it inline. Use the ↑ and ↓ buttons to reorder rows, click the eye icon (👁) to hide any field or section, or click + Quick Add pills.
